recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11342 unless Patient Care later decides to introduce a distinct relationship-type element instead of relying on the existing participant.member self-reference.
issue_request: FHIR-11342 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for CareTeam.relatedTeam or another composition relationship so care teams can contain or relate to other care teams. The accepted resolution was to support Reference(CareTeam) on CareTeam.participant.member and not add a separate relatedTeam or replaces element.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied in df58ee3f55a1d3406b2d01e380bf7e0001546445, whose subject explicitly included '#11342 CareTeam.participant.member support a reference to CareTeam'. Its CareTeam spreadsheet diff changed the member type from Reference(Practitioner|RelatedPerson|Patient|Organization) to Reference(Practitioner|RelatedPerson|Patient|Organization|CareTeam), and that behavior was carried forward when the source was refactored into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: CareTeam is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition lists CareTeam as a targetProfile for CareTeam.participant.member, and the CareTeam resource description/introduction says the resource includes people, organizations, and care teams. Later same-element issues added PractitionerRole, Group, and HealthcareService targets without removing or conflicting with the CareTeam target. Zulip background discussion shows the modeling question around CareTeams referencing CareTeams; no direct Confluence reference or conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current authoritative source already implements the accepted FHIR-11342 change. Adding a new relatedTeam element or extra prose would exceed the published resolution and duplicate semantics already conveyed by the member targetProfile and resource description.
